title: Receive what is given and keep the Naam
summary: The Lord gives, and mercy turns receiving into the Jewel of Naam. Unchosen circumstances become less barren when the hand reaches for remembrance.
takeaway: Meet the given day with Naam, not with a clenched inventory.
lifeApplication: When the day arrives unlike the plan, take one breath with Naam before counting losses. Let mercy name what can still be received.

source.shortMeaning: What He gives is received; by mercy the Jewel of Naam is found.
source.lifeApplication: When the day gives what you did not order, receive it and hold fast to Naam.

evidence.coreClaim: What He gives is received; by mercy the Jewel of Naam is found.
evidence.turn: Receiving under Hukam becomes fertile when it is joined to remembrance.
evidence.practicalImplication: When the day arrives unlike the plan, take one breath with Naam before counting losses. Let mercy name what can still be received.
